Concerns.Title: Between the Lines
Concerns.Pitch: Condition of the bed: shifting. The peat heaves after dark, and a stake that stood at nine at evening stands at eleven by morning. Nine and eleven are two different subjects. I cannot index a subject against a stake that will not stay where it was driven. Status of the survey: suspended. The scribe has entered a cause, maw-toads in the flooded cut to the west, and marked it claimed, not confirmed; the scribe marks everything that way. The tenth recension's own survey sheet is still on the reading table, weighted at the corners with peat bricks.
Concerns.Thanks: Stake nine: the adult with one hand open. Stake eleven: the child, curled, facing nine. Both where they were driven. Indexed. Thank you.

Approaches.Label: Re-drive the survey line: oak and binding, or willow for now.
Approaches.Objective: Re-drive the Drowned Ledger's survey line

Approaches.Label: Find what heaves the peat in the flooded cut west of the Ledger.
Approaches.Objective: Quiet the flooded cut west of the Drowned Ledger

Confront.Site: the flooded cut west of the Drowned Ledger

Approaches.Label: Read the tenth recension's survey sheet on the reading table.
Approaches.Objective: Read the tenth recension's survey of the bed

Refusal.Text: I will leave the stakes be.
Refusal.Reply: Said, and entered. Walk between the lines on your way out.
